parts.text: Give me three Tokyo strolls with independent menswear, excellent ramen, matcha, and one cultural stop.
Create three strolls in Paris, France, with independent ceramics shops, vegetarian bistros, specialty coffee, and modern architecture. Ceramics is mandatory in every route.
Plan three compact walks in New York City, USA, around record stores, bagels, espresso, and contemporary art.
Start each of three Tokyo, Japan strolls at Shibuya Station. Include independent menswear, ramen, matcha, and cultural attractions. I do not need to return to the station.
Create three compact walks in Los Angeles, USA, with independent bookstores, tacos, specialty coffee, and modern architecture.
